policy: the rules of the game for agents working in SGit-AI/SGit-AI__Website__Newsroom
status: proposed: written down, not yet enforced by anything outside the agent. This copy is published for reading; the copy that counts is meant to live in a repository the agent cannot write to.
principle: An agent may change content freely. It may change what checks its work only with a second key. It may never change its own rules.

zones.meaning: an agent may change these in a normal release
conditions: admin/build/version.txt only to the next version, as the tag-release job already checks

zones.meaning: files that check the agent's work: a change needs approval from someone other than the agent that made it
paths: every .js and .mjs file outside admin/build and assets/vendor: the code that runs in the reader's browser
zones.why: an agent that can change the check can pass any release, and code that runs in a reader's browser is not content; 62 of 227 commits from 11 to 22 October 2026 touched machinery files, from six agents, so the rule is a second key, not never

zones.meaning: who the agents are, which keys are published, and where the site is served
zones.why: an agent should not define itself, publish keys, move the site or change its own settings

zones.meaning: copied from another project and pinned by hash
zones.why: one code base, refreshed only from its source; the validator already checks the hashes

zones.meaning: this policy, and whatever enforces it
zones.why: an agent must not set its own boundaries

barriers.expectation: this file, read by the agent
barriers.setting: a hook or permission rule in the agent's harness, and a check in this repository's CI, both of which an agent with write access could change
barriers.boundary: rulesets and code-owner review on the platform, and checks in a repository the agent cannot write to, set by the owner

minimal_controls_today.catches: nothing on its own; it is what the other controls enforce

minimal_controls_today.control: deny rules and a PreToolUse hook in the agent's harness, for the gate, identity and rules paths
minimal_controls_today.catches: mistakes, at the moment of the edit; not a script that writes the file

minimal_controls_today.control: a guard job in this repository's CI: a push that changes a gate, identity or rules path, and did not arrive as a pull request approved by someone else, fails validation and does not deploy
minimal_controls_today.catches: mistakes the hook missed; defeating it needs a second, deliberate change to the workflow

minimal_controls_today.control: the agent's token without permission to change workflow files
minimal_controls_today.catches: any change to .github/workflows; the owner's step

minimal_controls_today.control: a repository the agent cannot write to, which checks each release against this policy and is the only thing that deploys
minimal_controls_today.catches: total compromise of the agent; the owner's step, described in the sidecar repository article
